node.statement: Write D_X=Delta_n X and F_X=Phi_n(D_X), and similarly for Y,Z. The exact product identity D_XD_YD_Z-F_XF_YF_Z=(D_X-F_X)D_YD_Z+F_X(D_Y-F_Y)D_Z+F_XF_Y(D_Z-F_Z), followed by complete contractivity of Delta and Phi and the assumed one-factor estimate, bounds its norm by 3d||X||||Y||||Z||. Applying the contractive outer Phi_n gives ||P0-P1||<=3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
